capabilities.body: OpenAmer hyehyɛ adwuma, de nnwinnade ankasa — ahyɛde mfɛnsere, intanɛt hwɛfo, fael ne koodu — yɛ, na ɛkora nea ɛyɛɛ yiye so.
capabilities.title: Ɔboafo a ɔne wo susuw nneɛma ho

capabilities.body: Nkɔmmɔ, nkae ne nhwɛso ahorow wɔ saa afiri yi so. Wɔmfa biribiara nkɔ intanɛt so gye sɛ wobisa.
capabilities.title: Wo mfiri, wo nsɛm

capabilities.body: Kasa 186, biara wɔ nkyerɛwee a wokenkan mu. App no kratafa a edi kan bisa nea wopɛ.
capabilities.title: Wo kasa, sɛnea ɛfata

capabilities.body: Wɔkora nimdeɛ a efi adwuma no ankasa mu so, enti dodow a wode di dwuma no, dodow no ara na daa nnwuma gye bere tiaa.
capabilities.title: Tumi a ɛkɔ so nyin

help: Hwɛ sɛ saa afiri yi tumi kɔ intanɛt so.
Yɛ nhyehyɛe no bio — wɔrensan nyɛ anammɔn a wɔawie no.
Sɛ ɛdi nkogu mprenu a, bue dwumadi kyerɛwtohɔ no; nkyerɛwde a etwa to no kyerɛ anammɔn no din.
failure.lead: Wɔansan akyi wɔ nsakrae biara mu wɔ sum ase — OpenAmer gyina nea ɛgyinae no, enti sɛ wosan yɛ a, ɛtoa so fi hɔ.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer da so wɔ nea edi kan no so na ɛkɔ so yɛ adwuma. Wɔannyɛ nsakrae biara fã pɛ.
failure.title: Nhyehyɛe no anwie

language.lead: Nhyehyɛe no bɛtoa so wɔ kasa a wopaw wɔ ha no mu. Wubetumi asesa no akyiri yi wɔ app no mu.
language.title: Paw wo kasa

progress.lead: Nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ pɛnkoro: OpenAmer retwe nea ehia na ɛresiesie saa afiri yi. Sɛ wobue no akyiri yi a, ɛrentwam saa anammɔn yi mu bio.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer de foforo rehyɛ nea edi kan no ananmu. Wɔrenka wo dwumadi bere, nkae ne nhyehyɛe.
progress.title: Wɔrehyehyɛ OpenAmer

stages.bootstrap-marker: Wɔrehyɛ sɛ wɔawie afiriso gu no
stages.configure: Wɔrehyehyɛ API nsafoa ne nhwɛso ahorow
stages.dependencies: Wɔde nneɛma a Python hia regu afiri so
stages.install: Wɔde foforoyɛ no regu afiri so
stages.node-deps: Wɔde nneɛma a Node.js hia regu afiri so
stages.platform-sdks: Wɔde nkrasɛm akwan SDKs regu afiri so
stages.repository: Wɔreyɛ OpenAmer koodu akorae no bi
stages.system-packages: Wɔde ripgrep ne ffmpeg regu afiri so
stages.update: Wɔretwe nea ɛyɛ foforo paa no
stages.uv: Wɔde uv nneɛma sohwɛfo regu afiri so

cards.body: Bue app no na kyerɛ adwuma a wopɛ sɛ wɔyɛ. OpenAmer yɛ adwuma wɔ akyi na ɛbɔ wo amanneɛ.
cards.title: Fa kasamu bi fi ase

cards.body: Nhyehyɛe → Nkyerɛ → Kasa. Kasa nhyehyɛe 186, wubetumi asesa bere biara.
cards.title: Paw wo kasa

cards.body: Adwuma a ɛsan ba bɛyɛ nimdeɛ — bere foforo no, ahyɛde baako pɛ na ehia.
cards.title: Ma ɛnkae

success.command: anaa fi ase akyiri yi fi ahyɛde mfɛnsere mu:
success.lead: Biribiara wɔ ne sibea. Afei OpenAmer yɛ wo de — wɔ saa afiri yi so, wɔ wo kasa mu.
success.title: OpenAmer ayɛ krado

bullets: Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ w'afiri so — wo nkɔmmɔ tena saa afiri yi so
Kasa 186, a nkyerɛwee a wokenkan ka ho
Wubetumi asesa biribiara akyiri yi; biribiara ntena hɔ afebɔɔ
welcome.lead: W'ankasa boafo. W'afiri so. Wo kasa mu.
welcome.leadUpdate: OpenAmer foforo ayɛ krado. Eyi hyɛ nea edi kan no ananmu na ɛkora dwumadi bere ne nhyehyɛe biara so.
welcome.note: Ɛgye simma kakraa wɔ intanɛt nkitahodi a ɛyɛ papa so.
welcome.title: Akwaaba ba OpenAmer
